passives.name: Blackout
passives.effects: When spotted by enemy stealthed wards or traps, gain Blackout for 8 seconds.

passives.name: Blackout
passives.effects: You disable surrounding stealthed wards, as well as expose and reveal nearby stealthed wards and traps while Blackout is active. Your basic attacks deal (2 /1) bonus true damage to wards.

passives.name: Nightstalker
passives.effects: After being not visible to enemies for at least 1 second, your next basic attack against a champion is empowered to deal 50 (+1.5 per 1 Lethality) bonus true damage on-hit. The empowered attack lasts for 4 seconds after being seen by an enemy.

description:
60 Attack Damage
18 Lethality

Nightstalker
After being unseen by enemies briefly, your next attack against a champion deals an additional true damage.

Blackout
When you are near enemy Stealth Wards and traps, reveal them briefly. While revealing wards, your attacks deal bonus damage to them.
